ev.q: Twelve persons experiencing homelessness with IPD were identified, six of whom used housing and social services at the same local shelter
Seven of 10 pneumococcal isolates with serotyping results were serotype 4.
Nine of the 12 patients were male, and eight were aged <50 years.
Weekly number of cases of invasive pneumococcal disease among persons experiencing homelessness
Ten patients were hospitalized for a median of 9 days (range = 3–14 days); no deaths were reported.
EPCPH initiated active surveillance at all local hospitals to identify additional IPD cases in persons experiencing homelessness.

methods_quotes.q: Analysis of cases was conducted to describe demographic characteristics, clinical presentation, codetection of respiratory viruses
Whole genome sequencing and single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) analysis of serotype 4 isolates showed that most isolates were not genomically related.
The average pairwise SNP distance between serotype 4 isolates was 89 SNPs.
